description: Fork of NicholasBly/youtube-webos (ad-free YouTube for LG webOS TVs), branched at upstream 0.8.1; upstream 0.8.2-0.8.4 ported on feat/upstream-sync-0.8.3 and feat/upstream-sync-0.8.4.
divergence: Dropped the entire legacy webOS 3-6 / Chrome 38 / ES5 build; only the modern Chrome 87 target ships
Removed babel.config.js, legacy browserslist targets, core-js-pure, @babel/runtime-corejs3, regenerator-runtime, babel-plugin-polyfill-*, whatwg-fetch, and all polyfills
Deleted the twemoji emoji-fix code path entirely
Converted config.js to typed config.ts with a 200 ms debounced localStorage write flushed on pagehide
Bundles all icons, logos and fonts locally already
Added a node:test suite and CI; does not use ad-hoc .cjs bench harnesses
app_api already gates debug logs behind a flag with poll backoff and timeout
Fixed the back-button issue #159 independently with an isAtTopLevel guard
Already fixed the options-panel ReferenceError and shortcut debounce
Has its own README, repo.json and version numbering; nothing is distributed, so no migration shims are needed

config.ts configRead/configWrite throw on unknown keys, where upstream's config.js returns undefined; any upstream code reading a computed key (e.g. `${category}Color`) must check the key exists first
Ported upstream 0.8.4's comments-fix.js (#188) and RYD header shift; the RYD .TXB27d virtual-list override is gone
Ported SponsorBlock full-video labels and time-with-skips, plus exclusive_access in FETCH_CATEGORIES, which upstream omits so its Exclusive Access badge never shows
Keeps its own spatial-navigation.js; upstream's spatial-navigation-polyfill.js is legacy-build only
Upstream converted every file to CRLF in 0.8.4; diff with --ignore-cr-at-eol -w
Comments carry no history of earlier approaches; upstream's comment-trim passes apply where the fork carries the same text
